preconditions.description: The length of the input string str is between 1 and 30.
The number of swap operations K is between 1 and 10.
All characters in the input string str are digits.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string is the same as the input string.
All characters in the output string are digits.

postconditions.expression: int(result) is not None and int(result) >= 0
postconditions.description: The output string represents a non-negative integer.
The integer represented by the output string is greater than or equal to the integer represented by the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(result.count(c) == str.count(c) for c in set(str))
postconditions.description: The output string contains the same frequency of each digit as the input string.
The maximum digit in the output string is greater than or equal to the maximum digit in the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(result.index(c, i) >= str.index(c, i) for i in range(len(str)) for c in set(str))
postconditions.description: The output string is lexicographically greater than or equal to the input string after each swap operation.
